text: Let him examine every man's talent; a peasant, a bricklayer, a passenger: one may learn something from every one of these in their several capacities, and something will be picked out of their discourse whereof some use may be made at one time or another.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book I, Chapter 25, Of the Education of Children
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
